title: A Layered Simplex Architecture for Large Alphabets
abstract: arXiv:2608.19908v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Probability estimation over large alphabets under log loss is a well-studied problem, with celebrated methods such as the Good-Turing estimator. We introduce and study a new Bayesian estimator with four notable properties. First, its construction is exceptionally simple: multiply independent uniform draws from the probability simplex coordinate-wise and renormalize. Depth is the only structural parameter, and averaging over depths eliminates the need to tune it. Second, the regret of the resulting mixture, the excess code length it pays relative to a code that knows the source, admits an explicit and efficiently computable expression. Third, despite its simplicity and lack of tuned constants, the estimator is competitive across a diverse set of synthetic and real-text benchmarks with substantially more specialized methods, including Good-Turing. Fourth, the tractability of its regret allows us to identify scaling laws in data, alphabet

translated_title: 一种面向大字母表的分层单纯形架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19908v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在对数损失下对大字母表进行概率估计是一个被广泛研究的问题，已有诸如古德-图灵估计器等著名方法。我们引入并研究了一种新的贝叶斯估计器，具有四个显著特性。首先，其构造极其简单：将来自概率单纯形的独立均匀样本按坐标相乘并重新归一化。深度是唯一的结构参数，而对深度进行平均则消除了调整它的需要。其次，所得混合模型的遗憾值——相对于已知源的编码所支付的超额码长——具有显式且可高效计算的表达式。第三，尽管其简单且无需调整常数，该估计器在多种合成和真实文本基准上，与包括古德-图灵在内的更专门方法相比，表现出竞争力。第四，其遗憾值的可处理性使我们能够识别数据和字母表中的缩放规律。
tldr: 本文提出一种极简的分层单纯形贝叶斯估计器，通过均匀相乘并归一化实现，无需调参，具有显式可计算的遗憾值，并在大字母表概率估计任务上与专门方法竞争，同时揭示缩放规律。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a minimal layered simplex Bayesian estimator that multiplies uniform draws coordinate-wise and renormalizes, requiring no tuning, with an explicit computable regret, matching specialized methods on large-alphabet probability estimation and revealing scaling laws.
